Passive similar to the Luminescent Oath and Ruinous Oath:
Every 2 seconds while luring a fish, decreases current control (bar size, not the value) by 10% (0.9x), and increases current progress speed by 10% (1.1x)
For example, after luring a fish for 6 seconds, the value will be ~-0.05, and the progress speed will be ~+17.3%.

Bar size: 35*(0.9)n/2, where n = seconds of the fish being lured
Progress speed: 13*(1.1)n/2, where n = seconds of the fish being lured
